title: Dentists and dental organizations
hypothesis: An active NPPES NPI-2 dental organization can yield a public business-contact candidate from an Authorized Official name plus a published AO or LOCATION line. It does not prove ownership, a direct personal contact, mobile status, reachability, or compliance eligibility; those require separate evidence and gates.
ownerSource: NPPES NPI-2 Authorized Official identity is an owner candidate only. A supported owner label requires independent, business-matched owner or founder evidence and an explicit direct business-contact link to the same published line.
phoneSource: Only the published NPPES Authorized Official or LOCATION business-contact field is in scope for the proposed alternative. Mailing, parcel, residential, and trace-derived private-phone paths are excluded from this review.

workflow.label: NPPES NPI-2 dental organization
workflow.detail: Read the free national NPPES organization route filtered to the requested dental taxonomy and state.

workflow.label: Active primary-taxonomy and AO filter
workflow.detail: Keep active records whose primary taxonomy matches the requested taxonomy and whose AO is a person; the current adapter excludes known staff titles.

workflow.label: NPPES scope hold
workflow.detail: Hold inactive, primary-taxonomy-mismatched, missing-person, or known staff-title rows.

workflow.label: Published business-contact candidate
workflow.detail: Retain AO or LOCATION phone provenance as a public business-contact candidate, never as a private owner-traced contact or handset claim.

workflow.label: No suitable public field
workflow.detail: Hold rows without a usable published business-contact field; do not use mailing, parcel, residential, or skip-trace data in this alternative.

workflow.label: Independent owner and direct-contact evidence
workflow.detail: Require current business-matched owner/founder evidence and an explicit direct business-role link to the same published line.

workflow.label: Ownership unresolved
workflow.detail: Hold DSO, multi-practice, employee, front-desk, conflicting, or unlinked evidence; an AO title or different line alone is insufficient.

workflow.label: Line and compliance gates
workflow.detail: Require authorized line type, reachability, DNC/TCPA, suppression, duplicate, freshness, and timezone controls separately from ownership proof.

workflow.label: Contact gate hold
workflow.detail: Hold non-mobile, unreachable, DNC/TCPA, suppressed, duplicate, stale, or timezone-unresolved rows.

workflow.label: Owner-confirmed delivery
workflow.detail: Deliver only after independent ownership/direct-contact evidence and all normal contact/compliance gates pass; no current NPPES dentist lane implements this delivery rule.

edges.label: inactive, primary mismatch, staff, or no person
missing, conflicting, DSO, or unlinked evidence
any line or compliance gate fails

failures.risk: A published AO or LOCATION line is represented as a private owner-traced contact because the current dentist route is recipe B.
failures.mitigation: Persist NPPES public-field provenance, prevent this lane from entering parcel/trace selection, and correct recipe-B presentation before delivery.

failures.risk: An Authorized Official, dentist title, or different phone is treated as proof of ownership or a direct owner handset.
failures.mitigation: Require assessOwnerEvidence with independent business-matched owner/founder and explicit direct-business-contact evidence; hold all unresolved rows.

failures.risk: Office manager, billing, credentialing, administrator, or coordinator AOs enter as owner candidates.
failures.mitigation: The NPPES adapter excludes its documented staff-title expressions before producing a name row.

failures.risk: A dentist listed only in secondary taxonomy is silently excluded despite the NPPES taxonomy query matching any taxonomy.
failures.mitigation: Treat this as a coverage limitation and add a separately tested any-taxonomy selection only after root review; do not weaken the owner gate.

failures.risk: Mailing, parcel, or residential data is used to uncover an unpublished phone.
failures.mitigation: This alternative admits only published NPPES business-contact fields and holds rows without one.

iterations.hypothesis: The existing NPPES dentist adapter admits active primary-Dentist AO candidates while rejecting known staff and non-primary dental records.
iterations.test: Five-case local fixture/code audit on 2026-09-24: three active primary-Dentist rows, one active office-manager AO row, and one active Dental-Hygienist-primary row with secondary dental taxonomies. Focused command: node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-name-pattern='nppes:' tests/lead-engine-registers.test.ts. No network, provider, append, trace, phone-verification, owner, compliance, or delivery call ran.
iterations.observed: The selected three primary-Dentist cases were kept; the office-manager case was held as staff_title_excluded; the Dental-Hygienist-primary case was held as primary_taxonomy_mismatch. The focused test passed. This measures parser behavior only and contains no phone, owner, handset, reachability, DNC/TCPA, or delivery outcome.
iterations.change: Propose a public NPPES business-contact lane with distinct AO/LOCATION provenance and an owner-evidence gate; block it from the legacy parcel/trace route until the runtime supports those semantics.

iterations.test: Focused synthetic regression checks in tests/lead-engine-industry-corrections.test.ts, lead-engine-reviews.test.ts, lead-engine-gates-jobs.test.ts and lead-engine-jobs.test.ts. No paid provider call.
iterations.observed: Export wording now uses row evidence. A published NPPES contact is no longer described as traced to a home merely because the job uses recipe B. All exported contact-status labels retain ownership unconfirmed. A complete independent owner-evidence pipeline remains pending.
iterations.change: Shared runtime correction integrated. Original source samples are retained with their original denominators; no phone-yield improvement is claimed.

measurement.result: Five selected saved NPPES dentist fixture cases: three active primary-Dentist AO rows kept, one office-manager AO held, and one secondary-only dentistry row held by the primary-taxonomy rule. Focused adapter test passed. Fixture/code audit only; no live source, phone, ownership, handset, reachability, DNC/TCPA, compliance, or delivery measurement.

cost.basis: Local five-case fixture/code audit only; no source fetch, provider, append, trace, review, or phone-verification call ran.
cost.note: No clean owner or business contact was measured. Historical brain benchmarks and the reported AO identity study have different denominators.

implementation.summary: Export wording now uses row evidence. A published NPPES contact is no longer described as traced to a home merely because the job uses recipe B. All exported contact-status labels retain ownership unconfirmed. A complete independent owner-evidence pipeline remains pending. Original review: The NPPES adapter and generic contact gates are implemented. Dentist jobs retain the legacy recipe-B route; a populated published AO line bypasses parcel and trace because those steps query only null-phone rows, and generic settlement has no assessOwnerEvidence call. The public-business-contact provenance and owner-evidence lane is therefore blocked pending a shared-runtime correction.

nextMeasurement: After the public-business-contact lane and owner-evidence gate are wired, run a lawful 5-20 row aggregate NPPES study. Separate active requested-taxonomy organizations, non-staff AO candidates, published-field presence, independent owner support, explicit direct-business-contact support, authorized line outcomes, and delivery. Do not use mailing, parcel, residential, or skip-trace data to find private phones.
